messages:
deploy-bot: ✨ Starting config-only deploy: cfg/limits/redispatch-v2.json -> canary 5% on prod, change window 30m. Trigger: routing+batching tuning for low-latency tails. Rollout owner: @alex_dev
alex_dev: flipping `routing.redispatch.enabled=true` and reducing `batch.max_tokens` from 2048 -> 1024 for canary. Pinning model variant to v2.1 for this path. release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/notes/2026-03-20-config-nudge
marta_rl: quick check — does redispatch affect dedicated customers? I thought it was host-only routing.
alex_dev: good catch. It only applies to hosted routing table; dedicated pools unaffected. Confirmed with routing team earlier.
carol_sre: watching 95/99 latencies and KV cache hit rate. I'll add a Grafana panel link in a sec. :eyes:
dave_prod: FYI, if we see KV hit drop we should increase `cache.prefetch_window` instead of rolling back. That keeps throughput but reduces tail.
observability-bot: canary metrics: qps stable, overall error rate 0.02% -> steady. 95th latency +12ms vs baseline. Link: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/redispatch-canary
sre-oncall: watching now. Will alert on >25ms 95th increase or >0.2% errors.
alex_dev: ack. If 95th <20ms increase after 15m we move to 25% canary.
marta_rl: adding note to release channel: "config-only: routing redispatch + batch.max_tokens=1024; canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% if stable"
deploy-bot: canary promoted to 25% at 3478910200. Gate: 15m monitoring.
observability-bot: after 10m check — 95th +18ms, 99th +40ms on embed-heavy routes. KV cache hit down 4%.
carol_sre: seeing a tail on embed routes specifically. Likely larger sequences hitting batch boundary more often.
dave_prod: suggestion: reduce `batch.target_batch_ms` from 12ms -> 8ms for embed route; that will lower wait time and tail. Can we apply a per-route override?
alex_dev: yes, we can target route `embed.*` with `batch.target_batch_ms=8`. I'll ship a config patch to canary only.
marta_rl: prefer small tweak over rollback. Ops: apply per-route override to 25% canary and re-evaluate.
sre-oncall: please also increase sampling for traces to 5% for embed.* for 30m so we can see end-to-end.
alex_dev: applied override to canary: per-route `embed.*` target 8ms. commit cfg/limits/redispatch-v2b.json
deploy-bot: config patch applied to canary at 3478910400. Monitoring gate 15m.
observability-bot: after 7m — embed 95th now +6ms vs baseline, 99th +12ms. KV hit recovering.
carol_sre: looks clean. No error spike. Agree to continue rollout to 100% over next 45m.
marta_rl: I'm going to update the release notes with the per-route tweak and rollout timeline. Noting rollback plan: revert to previous redispatch=false + batch.max_tokens=2048 if errors >0.2% or steady 95th >30ms for 10m.
dave_prod: leaving a quick runbook snippet here for oncall: `curl -XPOST https://api.redwood/deploys/config/revert -d '{"cfg":"redispatch-v2"}'` — only ops token scopes.
sre-oncall: I'll stand by. If anything flares I'll abort and mark for rollback.
deploy-bot: rollout completed to 100% at 3478910600. All gates passed. Summary: redispatch enabled globally, batch.max_tokens reduced for route group with per-route target reduced to 8ms for embed routes. No rollback needed.
alex_dev: thanks team. Will follow up with a short perf writeup and the final release note update. :tada:
